title: maDMP rules file
description: The format of one rules/*.json file: a 'standard' declaration plus a recursive tree of DMP fields. Two orthogonal facts per field: '_cardinality' says how many values ('1', '0..1' single; '1..n', '0..n' list), '_type' says what each value is ('object' for structured entities, otherwise a scalar format). There is deliberately no 'list' type: list-ness is entirely expressed by the cardinality. Three further coherence rules are enforced by rules/loader.py rather than here. They are expressible in JSON Schema (via if/then and a separate top-level field definition), but only at the cost of errors like "'object' should not be valid under {'const': 'object'}" in place of a sentence naming the field and the fix. They are: only '_type: object' fields may declare child fields, '_allowed_values'/'_suggested_values' may only appear on scalar fields, and '_chapter_description' may only appear on a top-level object field.

standard.description: Identifier of the standard this file defines, snake_case (e.g. 'rda_dcs'), unique across the files a project pins. It is the directory this file sits in, and the name a config's 'rules:' pin writes. Anything shown to a reader — DSW tags, QC reports — derives its label from it rather than carrying a second spelling.

version.description: Version of this standard. Must equal the file's own name: rules/standards/<standard>/<version>.json.

extends.description: false for the single base standard, true for every extension.

description.description: Free-form notes about this file's scope and conventions.

dmp.description: The root of the field tree, every key is a top-level DMP field. At least one: a rules file that declares no field constrains nothing.

_cardinality.description: How many values: '1' exactly one, '0..1' at most one, '1..n' at least one, '0..n' any number. 'n' means the field holds a JSON array.

_type.description: What each value is: 'object' for a structured entity with child fields, otherwise the scalar's expected format.

_description.description: Human-facing description of the field (question help text, QC reports).

_chapter_description.description: Description of the DSW chapter generated for a top-level object field. Only valid there — rules/loader.py rejects it anywhere else, where the generators would ignore it.

_allowed_values.description: Closed vocabulary: a value outside this list is a violation of the standard.

_suggested_values.description: Recommended vocabulary: a value outside this list is only worth a warning.
